entries.title: Location History
body: A widget shows your SIM's movements across different locations and the network events triggered by those transitions. To learn more, see Viewing SIM Details.

entries.title: Audit Logs
body: Added support for Audit Logs, which enables administrators to track configuration changes, view administrative actions, identify who performed each action, and review when changes occurred through a searchable and filterable audit log.
To learn more, see About Zscaler Cellular Audit Logs.

entries.title: Zscaler Cellular API
body: Zscaler Cellular supports the use of APIs that give you programmatic access to various Zscaler Cellular features and functionalities. The Zscaler Cellular API is accessible via OneAPI. The following API endpoints have been introduced to support Zscaler Cellular configurations:
To learn more about each endpoint, see the API Reference.
All endpoints are subject to a rate limit of 1,000 calls per minute, per tenant. To learn more, see Cellular API Rate Limits and Cellular API Codes.
The OneAPI Postman Collection is also updated to include new resources. To learn more, see Configuring the Postman REST API Client.

entries.title: Support for eSIMs
body: Zscaler Cellular supports eSIMs (embedded SIMs) in addition to traditional physical SIM cards, providing flexibility for organizations adopting eSIM technology. This enhancement allows administrators to view, manage, and activate both physical SIMs and eSIMs directly from the Zscaler Cellular Admin Portal.
- eSIMs provisioned to your organization automatically display on the SIMs page. The Form Factor column identifies whether a SIM is an eSIM.
- Administrators can assign, activate, or deactivate eSIMs directly from the Zscaler Cellular Admin Portal.
To access this feature, contact your Zscaler Account team.
To learn more, see About SIMs and Managing Assignment and Activation for eSIMs.

entries.title: User Interface Changes and Enhancements
body: The following user interface changes and enhancements are made to the Zscaler Cellular Admin Portal:
- Added Refresh button to specific pages (SIMs, Network Events, and Login Tracker) to fetch and display the latest data.
- Total SIMs, Used SIMs, and SIM State Overview widgets in the Dashboard support clicking the numerical value to go the SIMs page with approripate filter applied.
- Added an option on the SIMs page to download the list of SIMs with their details as a CSV file.
- Added support for filtering SIMs using tags from the SIMs page or SIM details page.
- Added the Total Usage field on the SIMs page to show data usage across SIMs in the current view.
To learn more, see Understanding the Zscaler Cellular Dashboard, About SIMs, and About Network Events.
